Please Note: This is a fully remote role; however, international travel is expected to collaborate with global RD labs, business units, and pilot customers.***

About Lenovo CTO Org

Lenovo CTO Org is the cutting-edge RD and technology incubation organization of Lenovo, dedicated to advancing information technology, smart devices, and services. Our mission is to transform breakthrough innovations into scalable businesses, powering Lenovo’s most advanced products and shaping the future of AI, edge computing, intelligent devices, and enterprise solutions.

About The Role

This is a hands-on technical role within the AI Solution Delivery organization of Lenovo CTO Org’s Tech Incubation team, reporting to the Director, AI Solution Delivery.

You will be responsible for deploying and operationalizing AI-powered solutions in real customer environments. Working closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, RD teams, and customers, you will bridge the gap between prototype and production by implementing, integrating, tuning, and validating solutions on-site.

Success in this role requires a combination of software engineering, applied AI, systems integration, and customer-facing problem-solving. You must be comfortable working directly with customers, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and adapting solutions to real-world operating conditions.

This role requires extensive travel and extended customer-site engagements, which may reach 70–80% depending on project needs and incubation phase.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Deployment Integration

Deploy AI-powered solutions in customer environments, including edge computing platforms, software applications, sensors, and supporting infrastructure.
Integrate solutions with customer IT and operational systems, APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms.
Develop and maintain integration code, automation scripts, and deployment tooling using Python and related technologies.
Assess customer environments and ensure deployment readiness, connectivity, and system compatibility.

Applied AI Solution Optimization

Configure, tune, validate, and troubleshoot Computer Vision and AI models in production environments.
Analyze field performance, identify root causes of accuracy issues, and optimize solution performance for real-world operating conditions.
Collect and analyze deployment data to support continuous improvement and model refinement.
Partner with RD teams to communicate field findings and accelerate product maturity.

Customer Delivery Technical Leadership

Serve as the primary technical lead for customer deployment activities, driving implementation execution and coordinating with architects, product managers, RD teams, and customer stakeholders.
Lead complex technical issue resolution and coordinate cross-functional engineering teams when escalations are required.
Conduct customer acceptance testing and validate deployment success criteria.
Train customer teams on solution operation, best practices, and troubleshooting procedures.
Field Documentation Knowledge Management
Create and maintain installation guides, deployment documentation, configuration records, and troubleshooting playbooks.
Document lessons learned and best practices to improve future deployments and accelerate solution scalability.

Feedback Loop Product Hardening

Serve as the critical feedback channel to the core RD team. Translate on-site deployment issues, hardware limitations, integration challenges, and algorithmic edge cases into structured, actionable engineering insights.
Capture and distill delivery experience into optimization recommendations for both software and hardware components, relaying timely feedback to Solution Architects and the RD team.
Compliance, Data Privacy IP Protection
Adhere to customer safety, security, privacy, and compliance requirements during all deployment activities.
Protect customer data and Lenovo intellectual property in accordance with company policies, contractual obligations, and applicable regulations.

What We Look For

Hands-on problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of software, AI, systems integration, and customer deployment.
Strong customer orientation and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where solutions are evolving rapidly.
Highly self-directed with strong ownership and accountability.
Passion for transforming innovative technologies into real-world customer success.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in solution deployment, systems integration, software engineering, field implementation, or related technical roles.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, AI/ML, or a similar degree.
Practical experience deploying, tuning, validating, and troubleshooting Computer Vision and AI-based solutions in production environments.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across software, infrastructure, and deployed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong communication and presentation skills with customer-facing experience.
Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, computer vision, AI platforms, or intelligent edge solutions is preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively and support long-term customer-site deployments globally.
Mandarin language proficiency is a plus.

The base salary range budgeted for this position is $180k - $235k. Individuals may also be considered for bonus and/or commission. Lenovo’s various benefits can be found here: https://www.lenovobenefits.com/enrolling-in-benefits/why-join-lenovo/

Company Overview

CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best

resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

About BizBuySell

BizBuySell operates the internet's largest and most heavily trafficked business for sale marketplaces, with more business listings, more unique users, and more leads delivered than any other platform. Our customers include small business buyers, sellers, owners, brokers, and others who need our information and services to help them buy or sell a business or franchise.

Learn more about BizBuySell- www.bizbuysell.com

Role Description

Data sits at the core of BizBuySell’s value—connecting buyer intent, listing quality, broker performance, traffic, and conversion outcomes across a complex multi-sided marketplace. We are searching for a full-time Lead Data Analyst to join our team to act as the senior-most individual contributor for analytics within the BizBuySell product organization. This role will own marketplace-level analytics, define analytical standards, and drive insight that shapes product strategy, monetization, and broker success. This is not a reporting-only role. You will operate as an analytics strategist and architect, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Leadership to answer the most ambiguous and consequential questions facing the business. As we expand our use of AI both internally and in customer-facing features, you will help assemble the datasets that power those capabilities.

This position is located in San Francisco and is 5 days onsite.

Responsibilities

Define and own core operational metrics to measure impact of enhancements, assess risks and drive revenue growth
Acquire and clean data from multiple sources; develop queries in order to conduct analysis and create business performance dashboards
Conduct exploratory data analysis to understand user behavior, product trends and areas of opportunity for major product initiatives (e.g., pricing, packaging, listing upgrades, broker tooling, experimentation)
Partner with Product and Exec leadership to inform roadmap prioritization and investment decisions, employing data visualization and statistical tools to deliver business insights
Establish standards for data quality, metric definitions, experimentation analysis, and dashboard design
Design and maintain canonical datasets and semantic models used across Product, Growth, and Sales
Own the data models and analytical foundations that power AI-driven product experiences
Reduce ad-hoc analytics load by building scalable self-service tooling and documentation

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree required from an accredited, not-for-profit, in-person college/university. 
A track record of commitment to prior employers. 
8+ years of experience as a data analyst.
Expert-level SQL and Excel skills.
Expertise with business intelligence software (i.e. Power BI, Looker, or equivalent).
Excellent communication skills—able to explain nuanced findings to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with data at scale in platforms like Databricks, BigQuery, and Snowflake in an AWS environment.
Knowledge of web analytics tools (i.e. Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager).
Exposure in performing data analysis and providing insights for high-traffic SaaS products, particularly with multi-sided marketplaces, conversion funnels, and cohort analysis.
Experience designing analytical datasets used in AI, machine learning, or rules-based optimization systems (e.g., scoring, ranking, recommendation, or classification).
Expertise with statistical analysis and data manipulation in Python.

What's in it for you?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside

the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement.

Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to):
Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug
Life, legal, and supplementary insurance

Reporting to the Director for the Gender Equity Center (GenEC), the Program Coordinator for the Gender Equity Center supports the center’s mission by managing daily operations, creating a welcoming environment, and assisting in the coordination, implementation, and assessment of programs and services that promote education, leadership, support, student success, professional development, and engagement activities for students; with a focus on addressing issues regarding gender.

Under the supervision of the Director, the Program Coordinator serves as a key point of contact for students, staff and community members and supports outreach, events, and program/campus initiatives. The Program Coordinator will train, supervise, and evaluate student undergraduate and graduate student assistants in a manner that empowers them to lead their own projects and achieve desired outcomes for the programs they support. By collaborating with campus and community partners, and by contributing to assessment and operational efficiency, the Program Coordinator helps ensure the GenEC remains a vital resource for fostering inclusion, creating safety for all Spartans, and student success.

Key Responsibilities

Designs, develops, and implements programs and workshops that support and promote education, advising support, leadership and professional development, and academic success for students; specifically addressing issues regarding gender.
Identify and address barriers to retention and graduation by creating specialized initiatives that meet student needs.

Collaborate with campus departments and organizations, and community partners on events and programs that focus on examining student’s gender experiences from an intersectional lens in relation to themselves and their communities.

Provides technical assistance and guidance for multi-site/phase environmental work processes, due diligence, subsurface investigation, and remediation projects. Determine well-defined data collection methods for extracting, identifying, and compiling environmental data from soil sampling, soil gas sampling, groundwater sampling, stormwater sampling, boring logs, and other matrices for projects, investigations, and surveys.
Assist with environmental site assessments (Phase I and II).
Research environmental hazmat databases regarding historical property land uses.
Coordinate site investigation, subsurface boring and trenching oversight, and monitoring of groundwater and extraction well installations.
Assist with oversight of drilling subcontractors during sample collection, well installations, and well abandonment.
Prepare data and visualizations such as mineral charts, soil analyses, groundwater modeling, maps geologic cross-sections, and other illustrations.
Maintain quality control standards and procedures for accurate and precise measurements, analysis, and reporting.
Assist with development and scoping of medium-sized projects.
Generate complete, accurate, and concise documentation using electronic systems and field/work site notebook.
Prepare technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, and recommendations to prevent, control, restore, or clean-up chemical and environmental problems and contamination.
Oversee equipment/tool performance, calibration, troubleshooting of malfunctions, and inventory control.
Assist in the analysis, evaluation, and interpretation of geologic, hydrogeologic, and chemical data obtained during field investigations, offering input with developing action plans for moderate- to high-level threat mitigation activities.
Work with cross-functional teams in executing project work.
Comply with safety guidelines and site-specific procedures which include but is not limited to, the maintenance of sample collection, trench and boring, laboratory documentation, written procedures, monitoring systems, and logbooks.
Prepare and implement site Health and Safety Plans (HASPs).
Comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the data integrity, documentation, procedures, training, monitoring systems, and record compliance and retention.
Interact with regulatory agencies, subcontractors, and clients in a confident and professional manner.

Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s Degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, or closely related discipline.
5 to 7 years of experience working as a Geologist.
Analytical skills, and proficient with geological research techniques and protocol.
Working knowledge with the concepts of reducing and eliminating the use or generation of hazardous substances, processes, or products., and mitigation programs.
Working knowledge of relevant environmental laws, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
